defs.def: 专指的，特指的（与泛指相对）

ex.s: This requires commitment to a particular occupation, branch of study or research.
ex.t: 这需要对某一特定职业、学科或研究领域的投入。

ex.s: Placing stress on particular words can have a big impact on the meaning and strength of apologies.
ex.t: 对特定词语的重读会对道歉的意义和力度产生重大影响。

defs.def: greater than usual; special 不寻常的；格外的；特别的

ex.s: This particular study examined 11 to 14-year-olds living in two-parent homes.
ex.t: 这项特别的研究考察了生活在双亲家庭中的 11 至 14 岁青少年。

ex.s: This particular feature also means we typically prefer things which offer minimum effort for maximum reward.
ex.t: 这个特别的特征也意味着我们通常更喜欢以最小的努力获得最大回报的事物。

defs.def: very definite about what you like and careful about what you choose 讲究；挑剔

ex.s: Characters' actions, or their behaviors, not only tell your readers what kind of people they are, but also drive the plot forward and create a particular atmosphere.
ex.t: 人物的行为,或者他们的行为,不仅告诉你的读者他们是什么样的人,而且还推动情节向前发展,营造出特定的氛围.

ex.s: She is particular about what she eats.
ex.t: 继续探索历史上的经典模型

defs.def: especially or particularly 尤其；特别；格外

ex.s: Is there anything else in particular that you'd like to share with us?
ex.t: 您还有什么特别想与我们分享的吗？

ex.s: The Kimberley region, in particular, is unique and untouched.
ex.t: 特别是金伯利地区，独一无二，未经人为触碰。

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s childhood was a difficult one, but he had one particular shining star in his life — his uncle, who was a well-known actor.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森的童年很艰难，但他生命中有一颗特别闪亮的星——他的叔叔，一位知名演员。

ex.s: Although parks of all sizes and types exist at any level, the national parks, in particular, tend ____41____ (catch) our attention because of their large size and variety.
ex.t: 虽然各种规模和类型的公园存在于各个层面，但国家公园因其面积广大和种类丰富而尤其____41____引人注目。

ex.s: This is   62   （particular） true in the US.
ex.t: 这在美国____62____（尤其/特别）是真的。

ex.s: Magazines are valuable assets for many people, but in particular to children.
ex.t: 杂志对许多人来说都是宝贵的资源，尤其是对孩子们。

ex.s: Yet as Martin has found in her work, gender is one of the fundamental ways people form connections with objects, particularly those designed with human characteristics.
ex.t: 然而，正如马丁在她的工作中发现的那样，性别是人们与物品建立联系的基本方式之一，尤其是那些被设计成具有人类特征的物品。

ex.s: We respond to stories, particularly when there is emotional detail.
ex.t: 我们会对故事产生反应，尤其是当其中有情感细节时。

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: It is particularly difficult.
ex.t: 它增加了艺术家的收入。

ex.s: Anger is a particularly strong feeling and maybe people think that they have reasons to feel angry.
ex.t: 愤怒是一种特别强烈的感觉,也许人们会认为他们有理由感到愤怒.

ex.s: He might not have done this particularly well,     46       the teacher told Gabriel that he had a good     47       and suggested that Gabriel go into the music store-room to see if any of the instruments there     48       him.
ex.t: 他可能做得不是特别好，____46____老师告诉Gabriel他有很好的____47____，并建议Gabriel去音乐储藏室看看那里有没有什么乐器____48____他。

ex.s: AI also significantly enhances the educational value of museums, particularly for children and families. _____39_____ For instance, interactive exhibits powered by AI can adjust their content and difficulty level based on the user's preferences and responses.
ex.t: 人工智能还显著提升了博物馆的教育价值，对儿童和家庭尤其如此。_____39_____ 例如，由人工智能驱动的互动展品可以根据用户的偏好和反应调整内容和难度。

ex.s: The government has struggled to come up with measures to address the problem, particularly in the poorer, rural areas east of the Volga River, including arranging doctor’s appointments by video chat and expanding financial aid programs to motivate doctors to practice medicine in remote parts of the country like Krasnoyarsk.
ex.t: 政府努力想出措施解决这个问题，尤其是在伏尔加河以东较贫困的农村地区，包括通过视频聊天安排医生预约，并扩大财政援助项目以激励医生到克拉斯诺亚尔斯克等偏远地区行医。

ex.s: New evidence suggests, however, that rainfall — particularly increasing autumn rain — is now contributing significantly to permafrost loss.
ex.t: 然而，新的证据表明，降雨——尤其是日益增多的秋雨——如今正在显著加剧永久冻土的消融。

ex.s: That’s particularly true during busy summer months.
ex.t: 这在繁忙的夏季尤其如此。

ex.s: If TMS is applied to a specific part of your brain behind your forehead that is particularly important for decision-making, you suddenly like different kinds of art.
ex.t: 如果TMS被应用到你前额后面的某个特定的大脑部分,对于决策特别重要,那么你突然喜欢不同的艺术.

ex.s: In India, particularly outside cities, young women are expected to move in with their husband’s family when they get married.
ex.t: 在印度，特别是在城市以外，年轻女性结婚后 expected 要搬进去和丈夫的家人住在一起。

ex.s: Kevin Balke, a research engineer at the Texas A&M University Transportation Institute, says that while smart lights can be particularly beneficial for some cities, others are so jammed that only a sharp reduction in the number of cars on the road will make a meaningful difference.
ex.t: 德克萨斯A&M大学交通研究所的研究工程师凯文·巴尔克(Kevin Balke)表示,虽然智能灯对一些城市特别有利,但另一些城市却卡住了,只有急剧减少路上的汽车数量才能产生有意义的变化.

ex.s: Fortunately, there's plenty of that happening right now, particularly the short-haul flights powered by batteries.
ex.t: 幸运的是，现在有很多这样的创新正在发生，特别是由电池驱动的短途航班。

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱斯解释道：“对许多老年人来说，特别是那些独居或在乡村生活的人来说，驾驶对于保持独立性非常重要，让他们能够自由出行而不必依赖他人。”

ex.s: When you’re riding on trains, you won’t be provided with a blanket for free, even if your trip is an overnight one. ____38____ In the summer in particular, the air conditioning can make them quite cold.
ex.t: 当你坐火车时，即使你是过夜旅行，也不会免费提供毯子。____38____ 尤其在夏天，空调可能让车厢相当冷。

defs.def: special or specific 特殊的；专门的；具体的

ex.s: As the world races to decarbonize everything, it faces particular problems with transportation — which accounts for about a quarter of our energy-related greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.t: 随着全球竞相为一切去碳化，交通面临着特殊难题——它约占我们与能源相关的温室气体排放的四分之一。

ex.s: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that words for your particular circumstances.
ex.t: 你可以把这些练习看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你打造适合自己特定情况的极简生活方式。

ex.s: Back in 1983, two scientists, Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin, reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，被昆虫叮咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够接收到。

ex.s: Back in 1983,two scientists,Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin,reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，被昆虫叮咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够接收到。

ex.s: I only joined my local athletics club because my doctor told me that in my particular case exercise could improve how my lungs work.
ex.t: 我之所以加入本地田径俱乐部，完全是因为我的医生告诉我，就我而言，运动可以改善我的肺功能。

defs.def: a fact or detail, especially one that is officially written down （正式记下的）细节，详情

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: The students feel that they belong to a particular group.
ex.t: 学生们觉得他们属于某个特定的群体。

ex.s: In my applications, I also began ___25___ clearly why I wanted that particular job.
ex.t: 在申请中，我也开始____25____清楚地说明我为什么想要那份特定的工作。

defs.def: written information and details about a property, business, job, etc. 详细资料；详细介绍材料

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从简单任务——比如找出一段阅读材料的主旨——转向需要心智抽象的任务——比如从文本中做推断——时，纸质阅读的优势尤为明显。
